该工作流程基于 Flux，可将照片一键转换为个性化漫画风格的图像和头像。它结合了用于风格控制的 LoRA 和用于内容引导的 ControlNet，使其变得像上传清晰的日常照片一样简单，无需参数设置或提示写入。为了获得最佳结果，建议与 LoRA 模型一起使用，例如“FLUX | Classic Shojo Manga Style - Cassiopeia_TypeA”和“FLUX | Y2K Shojo Manga Style - Cassiopeia_TypeB”。输出的色彩鲜艳、线条流畅、形状自然、细节富有表现力，是人物肖像的绝佳选择！

特点：

  1. 自动反向内容映射：无需输入提示关键字。

  2. 预设LoRA触发字：包括“FLUX | 经典少女漫画风格 - Cassiopeia_TypeA”的默认触发词。如果使用不同的 LoRA，您可以设置自己的触发词。

  3. 图像尺寸设置：从三种调整方法中进行选择（激活所需的节点组）；默认情况下，生成的图像尺寸与参考图像尺寸匹配。

·直接参考图像尺寸：自动使用参考图像的尺寸

·放大图像尺寸：放大输入以匹配参考图像的宽高比。 （注意：如果参考图像质量较低，可能会影响 ControlNet 准确处理它的能力。）您还可以使用此设置来放大和增强参考图像。

·设置固定大小和裁剪：可用于生成具有相同大小和相似构图的多个图像。此选项允许您根据图像左上角的 X 和 Y 坐标设置裁剪区域。

  1. 消极提示预配置:(为了保证风格的一致性，工作流程中预先配置了反向提示，除非有特殊要求，否则无需调整

说明：

  1. 上传该人的真实照片（清晰的日常照片就足够了）。

  2. 选择所需的 LoRA 模型并输入触发词（推荐 LoRA 模型：“FLUX | 经典少女漫画风格 - Cassiopeia_TypeA”和“FLUX | Y2K 少女漫画风格 - Cassiopeia_TypeB”）。

  3. 单击“生成”以创建图像。

❤️推荐参数❤️ （工作流程内预设；除非需要特定更改，否则无需调整）

  • 基础型号: 助焊剂

  • 图像尺寸：1024x1536（纵向方向可产生更好的字符效果）

  • 步骤：25–30

  • 采样器：DPM++2M

  • LoRA重量：0.8–1.0

  • 控制网实力：0.2–0.3（较高的值可能会影响LoRA效果）

  • ControlNet 启动百分比: 0

  • ControlNet 结束百分比：0.357

包含的模型仅供学习和参考；未经授权请勿用于商业用途！

FLUX｜古早少女漫画风格古早少女漫画风格-Cassiopeia_TypeA，更多信息请访问首页。

FLUX｜Y2K少女漫画风格Y2K少女漫画风格-Cassiopeia_TypeB，更多信息请访问首页。

感谢您的喜欢、下载和关注！请随时分享您的创作并发表评论——非常感谢！

o.en:
This workflow, built on Flux, allows for one-click transformation of photos into personalized manga-style images and avatars. It combines LoRA for style control and ControlNet for content guidance, making it as simple as uploading a clear everyday photo—no parameter settings or prompt writing needed. For optimal results, it is recommended to use with LoRA models such as "FLUX | Classic Shojo Manga Style - Cassiopeia_TypeA" and "FLUX | Y2K Shojo Manga Style - Cassiopeia_TypeB." The output features bright colors, smooth linework, natural shapes, and expressive details, making it an excellent choice for character portraits!

Features:

  1. Automatic Reverse Content Mapping: No need to input prompt keywords.

  2. Pre-set LoRA Trigger Words: The includes default trigger words for "FLUX | Classic Shojo Manga Style - Cassiopeia_TypeA." If using a different LoRA, you can set your own trigger words.

  3. Image Dimension Settings: Choose from three sizing methods (activate the desired node group); by default, the generated image size matches the reference image dimensions.

·Direct Reference Image Sizing: Automatically uses the dimensions of the reference image

·Enlarge Image Size: Enlarges the input to match the aspect ratio of the reference image. (Note: If the reference image is low-quality, it may affect ControlNet's ability to process it accurately.) You can also use this setting to upscale and enhance the reference image.

·Set Fixed Size and Crop: Useful for generating multiple images with the same size and similar composition. This option allows you to set the cropping area based on X and Y coordinates from the top-left corner of the image.

  1. Nagtive Prompt Pre-Configuration: (To ensure style consistency, reverse prompts are pre-configured within the workflow. No adjustments are needed unless there are specific requirements

Instructions:

  1. Upload a real-life photo of the person (a clear everyday photo is sufficient).

  2. Select the desired LoRA model and enter the trigger words (Recommended LoRA models: "FLUX | Classic Shojo Manga Style - Cassiopeia_TypeA" and "FLUX | Y2K Shojo Manga Style - Cassiopeia_TypeB").

  3. Click "Generate" to create the image.

❤️ Recommended Parameters ❤️ (Preset within the workflow; adjustments are unnecessary unless specific changes are needed)

  • Base Model: Flux

  • Image Size: 1024x1536 (Portrait orientation yields better character results)

  • Steps: 25–30

  • Sampler: DPM++2M

  • LoRA Weight: 0.8–1.0

  • ControlNet Strength: 0.2–0.3(higher values may impact LoRA effect)

  • ControlNet Start Percent: 0

  • ControlNet End Percent: 0.357

The included models are for learning and reference only; please do not use them commercially without authorization!
